title: Shelah's eventual categoricity and the prescribed-threshold obstruction

result.label: Shelah's eventual categoricity and the prescribed-threshold obstruction
result.statement: Proves Shelah's eventual categoricity conjecture in ZFC: for each bound on the Löwenheim–Skolem number, a uniform threshold makes categoricity of an abstract elementary class in one cardinal above that threshold imply categoricity throughout the same tail. Categoricity means uniqueness up to isomorphism at a given cardinality. Under the continuum hypothesis, a proposed specific Hanf threshold need not suffice.
